concerns.text: The idea's methodology sketch explicitly requires 'Apply Kolmogorov-Smirnov test to compare observed vs. simulated cross-correlation amplitude distributions.' The spec silently replaces this with a 'Monte-Carlo rank-test p-value' (FR-004, SC-001) with no stated rationale. A rank test is defensible, but the substitution is unacknowledged drift from the specified statistical procedure — either restore the KS comparison or add an assumption noting the deliberate change and why.

FR-012 (theoretical ISW curve per Granett et al. 2008) and SC-004 are additions not present in the idea, which only asks for comparison against Monte-Carlo ΛCDM simulations. This is plausibly implied by the supervoid hypothesis, but it adds a modeling deliverable (linear-theory ISW template) beyond the stated question — add a one-line justification in Assumptions tying it to the research question, or mark it as a stretch goal.
